_brief: Batch 2026-10-03 item 7 (Hospital Kids / Toys), video 3 of 3. Fast REACTIONS MONTAGE, five different children, none of them the subject of ek-hospital-hug, ek-hospital-doll or the crown story. COMPILATION-ORDER: 1 warmest/shortest face (girl laughing with her plush) -> 2 visibly different (baby boy and his Muslim mum laughing) -> 3 the strongest (pajama girl walks into Miss Israel's hug, slow-mo) -> 4 a boy in bed with Tal laughing -> 5 a baby girl and her delighted mum -> END the warmest: a girl's parents "we love you" -> Tal's heart hands and her laugh. Erez grammar: wide -> 4-frame snap -> tight -> cut. Captions only on the two lines that matter, both read with two models. Location sound, no music. grade:false + exposure:false.
beats: 1 HOOK (girl, ~9): she throws her head back laughing with her new green plush (IMG_8755). Crop keeps the floor-name plaque above her out of frame (V1 showed it)

PUNCH-IN cut (same take, time continuous): she squeezes it - "Thank you so much!" (2.74-3.46, two models agree) Out-point 3.93: "toda raba" ends 3.44-3.46 on two models, a third engine heard a word to 3.68 - out after both.
2 (baby boy, Muslim mum): Tal's hand gives him the toy box (IMG_8753, POV - the giving seen)
tight: he scrunches up laughing, then his mum laughs
3 STRONGEST (girl ~11, pajamas, plush under her arm): she walks into Miss Israel's arms (IMG_5655)
SLOW-MO: the hug (picture 2.8-4.6; sound real-time to 6.4, ending before a "thank you" that a second engine places at 6.72)

4 (boy ~9, in bed with his new toy): Tal leans in laughing (IMG_9241 first family - filming consent asked and given on tape at 14.1-17.1; the second family in this clip declined publication and is NOT used)

5 (baby girl, mum): the gift bag is handed over, mum delighted (IMG_8731; this window avoids the IV stand that is in frame at 12-15s; a wall monitor stays in the background) In-point 5.1 = the RMS dip (-42 dB) before mum's "wow".
6 ENDING (girl ~6 and her parents, IMG_5641): her parents watching her unwrap - "Look how much we really love you"
tight: her dad smiling, hand on his chin - "We love you! We love you!"
CUT other camera (IMG_8713, synced +0.71s, time forward): she looks up beaming In-point 86.5 (RMS -32) - V2 started at 86.6 on the onset of a voice (verify-cut flag).
